title.en: 5.1 Variable load and its effects on generation
title.gu: 5.1 Variable load તથા Generation પર અસર

h.en: Variable load and its effects on generation
h.gu: Variable load તથા Generation પર અસર

body.en:
Definition

Variable load is electrical demand that changes with time in magnitude,composition or both;generation and demand must be continuously balanced within system operating constraints.

Explanation and application

  • If generation and demand mismatch,system frequency tends to change;governors,reserves,dispatch and demand response help restore balance. AVR primarily regulates voltage/reactive support,not daily energy scheduling.
  • Plants must have adequate ramp capability,available capacity and reserves;installed MWalone does not prove reliability during outages or low renewable resource.
  • Part-load operation and starts can reduce efficiency and increase wear/cost,especially in thermal units. Peak demand can require equipment used for relatively few hours.
  • Load forecasting,staggering suitable processes,storage and interconnection can reduce peaks or improve flexibility;critical loads cannot simply be interrupted to improve a ratio.
Load-curve area?

Power integrated over time equals energy;MW×h=MWh.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Variable load એટલે સમય સાથે magnitude,composition કે બંનેમાં બદલાતી electrical demand;system constraints હેઠળ generation/demand સતત balance રાખવી પડે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Generation/demand mismatchથી frequency બદલાવાની વૃત્તિ થાય;governor,reserve,dispatch/demand response balance પુનઃસ્થાપે.AVR મુખ્યત્વે voltage/reactive support ગોઠવે,daily energy schedule નહીં.
  • Plantમાં adequate ramp,available capacity/reserve જોઈએ;માત્ર installed MWથી outage કે low renewable resourceમાં reliability સાબિત નથી થતી.
  • Part-load/starts efficiency ઘટાડે અને wear/cost વધારે,ખાસ thermal unitમાં.Peak demand માટે થોડા કલાક વપરાતું equipment જોઈએ.
  • Forecasting,suitable process staggering,storage/interconnection peaks ઘટાડે/flexibility વધારે;માત્ર ratio સુધારવા critical load બંધ નકરી શકાય.
Load curveનું Area?

Time સામે powerનું integration energy આપે;MW×h=MWh.

body.en:
Definition

A load is an electrical device or group of devices that draws power;load classification must state whether it is by consumer use,electrical behaviour or time duty.

Explanation and application

  • By use:domestic,commercial,industrial,agricultural,traction and public-service loads. Daily patterns differ by climate,work shifts and local habits.
  • By electrical behaviour:mainly resistive,inductive,capacitive and nonlinear loads;real power,reactive power and harmonic current affect different equipment limits.
  • By duty:continuous,intermittent,seasonal and short-duration peaks;essential and nonessential service are another distinction.
  • Adiversified group need not peak when every component peaks;use coincident measurements rather than summing noncoincident maxima as the station demand.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Load એટલે power લેતું electrical device કે devicesનો સમૂહ;classification consumer use,electrical behaviour કે time duty મુજબ છે તે સ્પષ્ટ કરવું.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Use મુજબ:domestic,commercial,industrial,agricultural,traction/public-service loads. Daily pattern climate,work shifts/local habitsથી બદલાય.
  • Electrical behaviour મુજબ:mainly resistive,inductive,capacitive/nonlinear loads;real/reactive power તથા harmonic current અલગ equipment limitsને અસર કરે.
  • Duty મુજબ:continuous,intermittent,seasonal/short-duration peaks;essential/nonessential service અલગ distinction છે.
  • Diversified group દરેક component peak સમયે peak કરે જ એવું નથી;station demand માટે noncoincident maxima ઉમેરવાને બદલે coincident measurement લો.

body.en:
Definition

A load curve plots demand against chronological time;a load-duration curve rearranges the same demands in descending order against duration for which each demand is equalled or exceeded.

Explanation and application

  • The area under either curve equals energy for the same period and units. MW×h=MWh;the vertical axis is power,not energy.
  • Chronological curve preserves when peaks and ramps happen;duration curve shows how long capacity levels are needed but loses their time order.
  • For unequal intervals,sort demand blocks with their durations. Do not average the demand values without weighting by hours.
  • Daily,monthly and annual curves use their own time bases;maximum demand depends on the declared measurement interval,not an arbitrary instantaneous spike.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Load curve chronological time સામે demand બતાવે;load-duration curve એ જ demandsને descending orderમાં ગોઠવી દરેક demand જેટલો કે વધુ load રહે તે duration સામે દર્શાવે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • સમાન period/units માટે બંને curvesની નીચેનું area energy છે.MW×h=MWh;vertical axis power છે,energy નહીં.
  • Chronological curve peaks/ramps ક્યારે થાય તે રાખે;duration curve capacity levels કેટલો સમય જોઈએ તે આપે,પણ time order ગુમાવે.
  • Unequal intervalsમાં demand blocks durations સાથે sort કરો.Hours weighting વિના demand valuesનો average નલો.
  • Daily/monthly/annual curvesની time basis અલગ છે;maximum demand declared measurement interval મુજબ છે,arbitrary instantaneous spike નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Connected load is the sum of rated powers of connected load devices on a common basis;maximum demand is the greatest demand over the stated demand interval within the observation period.

Explanation and application

  • Average demand=Pav=energy/period. Demand factor=maximum demand/connected load on matching kWor kVAbases;do not compare kWmaximum with kVAconnected load.
  • Load factor LF=average demand/maximum demand for the same period. It measures steadiness/utilisation of the observed peak,not conversion efficiency.
  • Diversity factor=sum of individual maximum demands/coincident group maximum demand. Coincidence factor=coincident group maximum/sum of individual maxima;they are reciprocals for the same defined group/time basis.
  • For nonnegative common-basis loads,diversity is at least unity and coincidence at most unity;demand factor generally does not exceed unity when connected ratings and operating assumptions are valid.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Connected load common basis પર જોડાયેલ load devicesની rated powersનો સરવાળો છે;maximum demand observation periodમાં stated demand interval પર મળતી greatest demand છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Average demand Pav=energy/period. Demand factor=maximum demand/connected loadમાં kW કે kVA basis સરખી રાખો;kW maximumને kVA connected સાથે નભાગો.
  • Load factor LF=average demand/maximum demand,સમાન period માટે.તે observed peakનું steadiness/utilisation બતાવે,conversion efficiency નહીં.
  • Diversity factor=individual maximum demandsનો સરવાળો/coincident group maximum. Coincidence factor=coincident group maximum/individual maximaનો સરવાળો;સમાન group/time basisમાં એકબીજાનાં reciprocal છે.
  • Nonnegative common-basis loads માટે diversity ઓછામાં ઓછું unity,coincidence વધુમાં વધુ unity છે;valid connected ratings/operating assumptionsમાં demand factor સામાન્ય રીતે unityથી વધુ નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Plant capacity is the stated rated electric power capability for the chosen plant boundary;factor definitions must distinguish the full observation period from actual operating hours.

Explanation and application

  • Plant capacity factor CF=actual energy/(rated capacity×full period).It includes downtime and part-load effects but is not thermal efficiency.
  • Plant use factor PUF=actual energy/(rated capacity×hours actually operating).It excludes the nonoperating hours from the denominator;state how operating hours are identified.
  • Utilisation factor UF=maximum demand/rated plant capacity on the same power basis. Here this is the syllabus power-station convention;other fields may use the term differently.
  • With Eenergy,Ccapacity,Pmmaximum,Tperiod and tonoperating hours:LF=E/(PmT),CF=E/(CT),PUF=E/(Cton),UF=Pm/C.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Plant capacity chosen boundaryની stated rated electric power capability છે;factor definitionsમાં full observation period તથા actual operating hours અલગ રાખવા.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Plant capacity factor CF=actual energy/(rated capacity×full period).તે downtime/part-load effects સમાવે,thermal efficiency નહીં.
  • Plant use factor PUF=actual energy/(rated capacity×actual operating hours).Denominatorમાં nonoperating hours નથી;operating hours કેવી રીતે ઓળખ્યા તે લખો.
  • Utilisation factor UF=maximum demand/rated plant capacity,same power basisમાં.અહીં syllabus power-station convention છે;અન્ય fieldsમાં termનો અર્થ બદલાઈ શકે.
  • E energy,C capacity,Pm maximum,T period તથા ton operating hoursથી:LF=E/(PmT),CF=E/(CT),PUF=E/(Cton),UF=Pm/C.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Use one period,power basis and plant boundary;C>0,Pm>0 and0<ton≤T.

Step-by-step solution

  1. From LF=E/(PmT)and UF=Pm/C,multiply:LF×UF=[E/(PmT)]×(Pm/C)=E/(CT)=CF.
  2. From PUF=E/(Cton),multiply by operating fraction ton/T:PUF×ton/T=E/(CT)=CF.
  3. Therefore CF≤PUF when ton≤Tand energy is nonnegative. If the plant operates throughout the period,ton=Tand CF=PUF.
  4. For the same group,diversity×coincidence=1by cancelling the sum of individual maxima and group maximum;this identity fails if the inputs use different groups or periods.

Interpretation and check

These are algebraic identities under stated definitions,not universal numerical values for every plant.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

એક period,power basis તથા plant boundary લો;C>0,Pm>0 તથા0<ton≤T.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. LF=E/(PmT)અને UF=Pm/Cથી ગુણો:LF×UF=[E/(PmT)]×(Pm/C)=E/(CT)=CF.
  2. PUF=E/(Cton)ને operating fraction ton/Tથી ગુણો:PUF×ton/T=E/(CT)=CF.
  3. તેથી ton≤T અને energy nonnegative હોય ત્યારે CF≤PUF.પૂર્ણ period operation હોય તો ton=T અને CF=PUF.
  4. સમાન groupમાં individual maxima sum/group maximum રદ કરતાં diversity×coincidence=1.અલગ group/periodના inputsથી આ identity લાગુ નથી.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

આ stated definitions હેઠળ algebraic identities છે;દરેક plantનાં fixed numerical values નથી.

h.gu: Loss factor તથા Load factorનો ભેદ

body.en:
Definition

Loss factor is average power loss divided by maximum power loss over the same period and boundary;it is not average load divided by maximum load.

Explanation and application

  • For constant resistance,voltage and power factor with loss proportional to load squared:LLF=Σ[(Pi/Pm)²ti]/T. Actual system losses can include fixed and nonquadratic components.
  • Under the stated nonnegative bounded-load model:LF²≤LLF≤LF. LLF is not generally LF² because the mean of squares differs from the square of the mean.
  • Empirical formulas combining LFand LF²require a declared validated coefficient;no single coefficient is an exact law for all networks.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Loss factor એ સમાન period/boundaryમાં average power lossનો maximum power loss સાથેનો ગુણોત્તર છે;average load/maximum load નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Constant resistance,voltage/power factor તથા loss∝load² હોય ત્યારે LLF=Σ[(Pi/Pm)²ti]/T. Actual system lossesમાં fixed/nonquadratic components હોઈ શકે.
  • Stated nonnegative bounded-load modelમાં LF²≤LLF≤LF. LLF સામાન્ય રીતે LF² નથી;mean of squares/square of mean અલગ છે.
  • LF તથા LF²નું empirical formula declared validated coefficient માગે;કોઈ single coefficient દરેક network માટે exact law નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Base load is the demand level persisting for a long period;peak load is the additional demand above the selected base level during high-demand intervals.

Explanation and application

  • Base-duty choices favour sustained economical output and availability;coal,nuclear and some hydro or other contracted resources can serve this role subject to system conditions.
  • Peak-duty choices favour fast start,ramp and flexible operation;reservoir hydro,pumped storage,gas turbines,storage and demand response are possible resources with their own constraints.
  • Roles are not permanent laws based only on fuel. A reservoir can be energy-limited,a battery has duration limits and a nuclear/coal unit may have flexible operating capability within approvals.
  • Selecting a base level from a load-duration curve shows the energy split,but actual scheduling also requires chronology,reserves,ramp rates and network limits.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Base load લાંબા સમય રહેતું demand level છે;peak load high-demand intervalsમાં પસંદ base level ઉપરનું વધારાનું demand છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Base-duty માટે sustained economical output/availability અનુકૂળ છે;system conditions મુજબ coal,nuclear તથા કેટલાક hydro/contracted resources આ role ભજવી શકે.
  • Peak-dutyમાં fast start,ramp/flexibility જોઈએ;reservoir hydro,pumped storage,gas turbine,storage/demand response પોતાના constraints સાથે વિકલ્પ છે.
  • Roles માત્ર fuel આધારિત કાયમી નિયમ નથી.Reservoir energy-limited,battery duration-limited હોઈ શકે;nuclear/coalમાં approval હેઠળ flexibility હોઈ શકે.
  • Load-duration curveથી base level પસંદ કરતાં energy split મળે;actual schedule માટે chronology,reserve,ramp/network limits પણ જોઈએ.

title.en: 5.6 Numerical based on load curves and factors
title.gu: 5.6 Load curves તથા Factors આધારિત Numerical

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Assumed daily blocks:0–6h20MW,6–14h40MW,14–20h60MW,20–24h0MW. Rated capacity80MW,connected load120MW,individual group maxima48MWand42MW.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Energy=6×20+8×40+6×60+4×0=800MWh. Average=800/24=33.333MWand maximum=60MW.
  2. LF=33.333/60≈0.55556;demand factor=60/120=0.5;diversity=(48+42)/60=1.5;coincidence=60/90≈0.66667.
  3. CF=800/(80×24)=0.41667;operating hours20;PUF=800/(80×20)=0.5;UF=60/80=0.75.Check LF×UF≈0.41667.
  4. Duration order:60MWfor6h,40MWfor8h,20MWfor6h,0MWfor4h. Area remains800MWh;the original time of the60MWpeak is no longer recoverable from this sorted curve alone.
  5. Under the stated squared-loss assumptions:LLF=(6×20²+8×40²+6×60²)/(24×60²)=0.425926;LF²≈0.308642≤LLF≤0.555556.
  6. For a chosen40MWbase split:base energy=6×20+8×40+6×40=680MWh;peak energy=6×20=120MWh. Total remains800MWh. This does not establish an optimal plant mix.

Interpretation and check

All observations are synthetic teaching data,not Gujarat real-time generation. No comparison uses mixed kWand kVA.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

ધારેલા daily blocks:0–6h20MW,6–14h40MW,14–20h60MW,20–24h0MW. Rated capacity80MW,connected load120MW,individual group maxima48MW તથા42MW.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Energy=6×20+8×40+6×60+4×0=800MWh. Average=800/24=33.333MW તથા maximum=60MW.
  2. LF=33.333/60≈0.55556;demand factor=60/120=0.5;diversity=(48+42)/60=1.5;coincidence=60/90≈0.66667.
  3. CF=800/(80×24)=0.41667;operating hours20;PUF=800/(80×20)=0.5;UF=60/80=0.75.Check LF×UF≈0.41667.
  4. Duration order:60MW માટે6h,40MW માટે8h,20MW માટે6h,0MW માટે4h. Area800MWh જ રહે;sorted curveથી60MW peakનો original સમય મળતો નથી.
  5. Stated squared-loss assumptionsમાં LLF=(6×20²+8×40²+6×60²)/(24×60²)=0.425926;LF²≈0.308642≤LLF≤0.555556.
  6. પસંદ કરેલા40MW base splitમાં base energy=6×20+8×40+6×40=680MWh;peak energy=6×20=120MWh. Total800MWh જ રહે.આ optimal plant mix સાબિત કરતું નથી.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

બધા observations synthetic teaching data છે,Gujarat real-time generation નહીં.kW/kVA mix કરેલા નથી.

body.en:
Task and status

Use referenced or clearly synthetic chronological demand blocks;calculate energy,max/average,load/capacity factors and discuss ramps,reserves,part-load and feasible mitigation.

Report plan

  1. Prepare approximately five pages with aim,scope and source/date details;use the source requirement,not invented visit evidence.
  2. Collect genuine permitted evidence and retain original units,timestamps and data boundaries;cite every external capacity or generation claim.
  3. Organise a comparison table or labelled diagram and explain assumptions,missing records and safety limitations.
  4. Compute from the actual collected dataset only;separate worked synthetic examples from measured data.
  5. Conclude with engineering interpretation,limitations,references and an evidence appendix;do not invent signatures or certificates.

Blank record fields

Station/project | unit boundary | source URL | source date | timestamp/time zone | interval | MWor MWh/MU | status | evidence filename. All values blank until collected.
body.gu:
કાર્ય તથા સ્થિતિ

Referenced કે clearly synthetic chronological demand blocksથી energy,max/average,load-capacity factors ગણો;ramp,reserve,part-load/feasible mitigation ચર્ચો.

Report plan

  1. Aim,scope/source-date details સાથે આશરે પાંચ pages બનાવો;source requirement લો,બનાવટી visit evidence નહીં.
  2. Genuine permitted evidence લો;original units,timestamps/data boundaries રાખો;દરેક external capacity/generation claim cite કરો.
  3. Comparison table/labelled diagram બનાવો;assumptions,missing records/safety limits સમજાવો.
  4. Actual collected datasetથી જ report calculation કરો;synthetic examples/measured data અલગ રાખો.
  5. Engineering interpretation,limitations,references/evidence appendix આપો;signatures/certificates નબનાવો.

ખાલી Record fields

Station/project | unit boundary | source URL | source date | timestamp/time zone | interval | MW કે MWh/MU | status | evidence filename. Data મળ્યા સુધી values blank.

  3. Comparison table/labelled diagram બનાવો;assumptions,missing records/safety limits સમજાવો.
  4. Actual collected datasetથી જ report calculation કરો;synthetic examples/measured data અલગ રાખો.
  5. Engineering interpretation,limitations,references/evidence appendix આપો;signatures/certificates નબનાવો.
